title: Quantitative Universal Approximation for Noisy Quantum Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2604.02064v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We prove a quantitative universal approximation theorem for noisy quantum neural networks (QNNs), with explicit non-asymptotic error bounds in terms of the number of accuracy blocks, the qubit count, the number of two-qubit gates, and hardware noise parameters. Motivated by quantitative finance, where target functions are expectations of payoffs, we first extend existing noiseless bounds to expectation functions and derive explicit constants for exponential Levy models, covering the Black-Scholes price of (truncated) European Put options. We then formulate the noisy circuit via quantum channels, obtain a fidelity-based bound for general noise models, and specialise to depolarising noise with readout error, calibrated to real hardware. Finally, we provide a detailed numerical analysis for option pricing in the Black-Scholes model, testing our results on actual noisy quantum hardware.

translated_title: 噪声量子神经网络的定量通用逼近
translated_abstract: 我们证明了噪声量子神经网络（QNNs）的定量通用逼近定理，给出了关于精度块数量、量子比特数、双量子比特门数量以及硬件噪声参数的显式非渐近误差界。受量化金融中目标函数为收益期望的启发，我们首先将现有的无噪声界扩展到期望函数，并针对指数Levy模型推导出显式常数，涵盖了（截断的）欧式看跌期权的Black-Scholes价格。随后，我们通过量子信道对噪声电路进行形式化表述，获得了适用于一般噪声模型的基于保真度的误差界，并专门针对带有读取误差的去极化噪声进行推导，其参数根据真实硬件进行了校准。最后，我们对Black-Scholes模型中的期权定价进行了详细的数值分析，并在实际的噪声量子硬件上验证了我们的结果。
tldr: 本文证明了带显式非渐近误差界的噪声量子神经网络定量通用逼近定理，将其应用于Black-Scholes期权定价，并在真实噪声量子硬件上验证了理论结果。
